description: Automatic decimal inputs resolve the three original signed BIGINT SUM/AVG overflow cases. Broad production qualification remains incomplete.

survey_workflow.meaning: Successful collection means the survey completed, not that every case passed.

fixed_original_cases.sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);
SELECT SUM(CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);
SELECT AVG(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);
SELECT SUM(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);
SELECT SUM(CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);
SELECT AVG(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS BIGINT)) FROM example.sequence(10);

earlier_local_attempt.observation: An intermediate run, before the view fix, also encountered EOF while attaching a subprocess worker. The subsequent full local suite and all CI jobs passed without adding retries.

provenance_note: The full local Java run passed 85 tests. A subsequent targeted run passed the strengthened AVG view assertion. GitHub verification covers the recorded candidate. Later changes only add documentation and this record.
limits: Input arithmetic is not automatically widened.
The complete 448-file upstream inventory was not rerun.

reproduction.gate: Use the commands in .github/workflows/ci.yml at connector_revision.
